title: Page 4
content_zh:
果然还是太生嫩了，随便撩拨几句就坐不住了。赵若瑾暗笑在心，放空的眼神看向窗外。
因为当千金小姐真的太无聊了，除了习字，她还跟着花嬷嬷学打络子，裁布做鞋缝衣，绣个花鸟什么的，还藉着装傻卖萌，怂恿自以为聪明的妹妹让父亲请了先生教琴棋书画，以及礼仪和进退规矩。
除了琴她真的不行外，其他还学得不错，尚可拿出手见人。
拜多活了一世的福气，她学得很快，不过要小小掩饰一下，不能表现太好，让人发觉她不是“古代土着”。
而当一切都学上手了之后，她又觉得无聊了，忧患意识又开始冒出头，虽然侯府不穷，当年分家时爹分了不少银两、土地和铺子，娘的陪嫁也很多，但那是他们的，不在自己手中就不是自己的，何况家里不是只有她一个孩子。
现在还看不出将来的变化，可大哥若娶了一个和她们不和的嫂子呢？或者愚昧，贪心护财，等她们要出嫁时，能有多少陪嫁是未知数，她不想把自己的未来赌在别人手上。
别人有不如自己有，那是谁也抢不走。
以她上辈子在金融业混得风生水起的头脑，要赚饱荷包并不困难，前提是得光明正大纳为私产，不必上缴公中，要不然赚的全是别人的，那还有什么意思？
赵若瑜真的很单纯，毫无半点宅斗的功力，她不过说了一句“要是能用自己赚的银子买衣服首饰，以后就不用向娘伸手要钱了”，立刻启动她现代人思维，充满高人一等优越感的发胀脑子，二话不说地想发挥别人没有的金手指。
“你要管铺子？”徐氏犹豫的看着女儿，她不想女儿太辛苦，这么小的年纪就要学人理事。她心疼。
“是我和姊姊，你一人给我们两间铺子玩玩，反正赔也赔不了多少，就当让我们练手。”她不忘多拖一人下水，表示不是她一个人，姊妹们到了年纪都要试着管事。
“这……”她俩才几岁呀！管得来吗？
徐氏名下的嫁妆就有十来间铺子，拿几间给女儿玩玩也不算什么，她还不在乎那几千两的损失，唯一放不下心的是担心她们被骗，受了打击，日后灰了心不敢再接手府中庶务。
“娘，你就当提前给我们嫁妆嘛！是赔是赚由我们自理，趁我们还小时多接触，多跌几次以后我们就学聪明了，不会在同一个坑里跌两次。”赵若瑜眼中闪着亮光，彷佛已看到银子滚滚而来的荣景，叫人觉得好笑，她想得也太远。
看着小女儿发光的小脸，徐氏不忍心毁掉她的“雄心壮志”，转头问道：“乐姊儿，你呢？你也想学做生意？”
“啊，什么？”那只鸟儿真好看，蓝羽白腹，尾长一尺。
看到大女儿一脸无知的回过神，徐氏哭笑不得，“笑姊儿想打理娘的铺子，那你要不要呢？”
哦！是这件事呀！赵若瑾正想着要讨要哪几间铺子，哪知她这一停顿看在母亲眼里，以为她又犯傻了，一阵不安地想给她最好的，省得傻女儿费心。
“娘，我先挑，我要东街的两间铺子，一间开酒楼，一间做绸缎庄，兼卖成衣。”怕好的铺子先被姊姊挑走了，赵若瑜一开口就挑走母亲嫁妆中最好的两间。
“哎呀！你这孩子真贪心，好的铺子你先挑了，让娘要给姊姊什么。”京城里什么都贵，那两间铺子没三、五万两是买不下，她原本打算给两个女儿一人留一间，以后嫁了人才有底气。

“姊，你不会跟我争对不对？我比你小，你要让我。”赵若瑜眼里闪过一丝得意和狡猾，稚气的脸庞上有着恍如成年女子的清傲，在她的想法里，凡是好的都是她的，她赚了钱再分给吃亏的姊姊就是。
看她已是把铺子当囊中物的神情，赵若瑾暗自好笑，睁大一双眼表示无所谓的道：“没关系，妹妹想要就给她，我只要小小的铺子就好，娘在福乐街不是有两间铺子？我脑子不灵光，开不了大铺子。”
“可是那两间铺子真的不大，加起来还不如东街一间铺子大。”六、七千两就买得到，而且地段不甚繁荣。
“娘，要不你再给一处附庄子的两百亩田地，我以后开米铺，卖自家种的米粮，那就不必去操心货源，也不怕被人骗，卖多少赚多少，不会亏本。”
这是最保本的做法，她要先有进项才能图谋其他，毕竟以她的年纪还不足以慑服人，抛头露面与人洽谈生意是不会有人理会她，总得要先做出一番成绩才能令人信服，不因她年幼而心存蔑视，在货物的价格上多加刁难，欺她无知。
“啊！这样好，娘手上刚好有处两百五十亩地的小庄子，每年的稻作产量可不少，若无遇洪水干旱，收的稻米够你卖的了。”觉得大女儿吃亏了，徐氏主动送上最不发愁的土地，米粮最不亏本了，卖了都是银子。
“娘，我也要地。”看姊姊有，最讨厌种地的赵若瑜也嚷着讨要，她这人看别人有自己也一定要有。
徐氏看向小女儿的眼神有些微妙了，脸上的笑容也变淡了。“那就拿你一间铺子跟姊姊换，娘也给你庄子。”
“不要，我不换。”一想到东街的铺子有多值钱，她马上护得紧紧地，唯恐人家来抢。
这孩子，有点被宠坏了。“笑姊儿，做人不可太贪心、急功近利，咱们府里就你和你姊姊两个闺女，你们以后嫁了人也要相互扶持，不要为了小利而坏了姊妹情，这世上再亲也亲不过父母手足，只有爹娘和兄弟姊妹才是真心对你好。”
赵若瑜在心里想着：才怪，一旦有了利益冲突，再亲近的人也会反目成仇，我谁也不信，只信自己。“是的，娘，我不要庄子了，光是两间铺子就够我忙了，唉！好累。”
她口服心不服，装出乖顺的模样，逗得母亲开怀大笑。
“呿！还没做就嫌累，要不要娘把铺子收回来，省得累坏我的宝贝女儿。”她还真舍不得心头肉受累。
“别别别，娘，我不怕累，我还要赚大钱给你打十二副金头面，让你戴着出门风光风光。”尚未赚到钱的她先夸下海口，好像银子是地上的石头，扫一扫就有了。
“好，娘等着你的金头面，让你孝敬。乐姊儿，你铺子小，要不要娘贴补贴补……欸！怎么又发呆了，娘的话听进去了没？”担心完小的，又来操心大的，两个来讨债的丫头。
正在想另一间铺子卖什么的赵若瑾在妹妹的轻扯下回过神，傻气地笑道：“不用娘贴补，小铺子而已，而且我这几年也攒了不少银锞子，我有钱。”
她的小金库里还真堆了不少财宝，从她的满月礼到每年的生辰，以及长辈们给的压岁钱，宫里也有赏赐，还有娘带她和妹妹到各府走动，粉妆玉琢的孪生子谁不爱，众家夫人看得欢喜便送金送银，长生锁、玉镯发簪什么的，没几百两人家还送不出手。
毕竟门户摆在那里，兴武侯府可不是一般小老百姓家，圣宠仍在，家眷常被皇后、太后宣进宫伴驾，礼送得轻了是送礼的人丢脸。
因此她收得盆满钵满，七年下来已经累积不小的财富。
再说她用钱的地方并不多，她不像妹妹大手大脚的乱花银子，见到什么都想买，爱与人比这比那的，说起来赵若瑜的私房并不多，约是她的零头而已，想来就算给了赵若瑜赚钱的大铺子，只怕她也撑不起来。
content_en:
Sure enough, she is still too raw and can't sit still even if she casually teases her a few words. Zhao Ruojin smiled secretly and looked out the window with empty eyes.
Because being a rich girl is really boring, in addition to practicing calligraphy, she also learned from Grandma Hua to tie clothes, cut cloth to make shoes and clothes, embroider flowers and birds, etc. She also pretended to be stupid and cute, and encouraged her younger sister who thought she was smart to let her father hire a husband to teach her music, chess, calligraphy and painting, as well as etiquette and rules of advancement and retreat.
Except for the piano, which she is really not good at, she has learned other things quite well, and can show her skills to others.
Thanks to the blessing of living an extra life, she learned quickly, but she had to cover it up a little and not act too good, so that people would notice that she was not an "ancient aboriginal".
But after she learned everything, she felt bored again, and her sense of worry began to emerge again. Although the Hou family was not poor, her father divided a lot of money, land and shops when the family was separated, and her mother also had a lot of dowry, but it was theirs. If it was not in her hands, it was not hers, not to mention that she was not the only child in the family.
We can't see the future changes now, but what if the eldest brother marries a sister-in-law who is at odds with them? Or they are ignorant and greedy to protect their wealth. When they get married, it is unknown how much dowry they will have. She does not want to bet her future in the hands of others.
What others have is not as good as what you have, and no one can take it away.
With her mind, which had prospered in the financial industry in her previous life, it was not difficult to make a full wallet. The premise was that it was kept as private property openly and did not have to be turned over to the public. Otherwise, all the money earned belonged to others, so what's the point?
Zhao Ruoyu is really simple and has no skills in house fighting. She just said, "If you can use the money you earn to buy clothes and jewelry, you won't have to ask your mother for money in the future." She immediately activated her modern thinking, filled her head with a sense of superiority, and without saying a word, she wanted to use her golden fingers that others did not have.
"You want to manage the shop?" Mrs. Xu looked at her daughter hesitantly. She didn't want her daughter to work too hard and have to learn how to manage at such a young age. She felt distressed.
"It's me and my sister. You can give us two shops to play with. You won't pay much anyway, so let us practice our skills." She did not forget to drag one more person into the water, indicating that she was not the only one. The sisters should try to take charge of things when they get older.
"This..." How old are they? Can you manage it?
The dowry under Xu's name included about a dozen shops, and it didn't matter how many shops she gave to her daughter to play with. She didn't care about the loss of several thousand taels. The only thing she couldn't let go of was that she was worried that they would be deceived and hit, and they would be discouraged and dare not take over the government affairs in the future.
"Mom, just give us a dowry in advance! It's up to us to take care of whether we pay or make money. Let's have more contact with each other while we are still young. After falling a few times, we will learn to be smarter and won't fall into the same pit twice." Zhao Ruoyu's eyes were shining brightly, as if she had seen the prosperity of money rolling in. It was funny, but she thought too far.
Looking at her little daughter's glowing face, Mrs. Xu couldn't bear to ruin her "ambition", so she turned around and asked, "Sister Le, what about you? Do you also want to learn to do business?"
"Ah, what?" That bird is so beautiful, with blue feathers, a white belly, and a foot-long tail.
Seeing her eldest daughter come back to her senses with an ignorant look on her face, Mrs. Xu couldn't laugh or cry, "Sister Xiao wants to take care of my mother's shop, do you want to do that?"
Oh! This is it! Zhao Ruojin was thinking about which shops to ask for, but she didn't know that her pause was seen in her mother's eyes, thinking that she was being stupid again, and she felt uneasy and wanted to give her the best to save her stupid daughter the trouble.
"Mom, I'll choose first. I want two shops on East Street. One is a restaurant, and the other is a silk and satin shop that also sells ready-made clothes." Zhao Ruoyu was afraid that the good shops would be picked out by her sister first, so Zhao Ruoyu picked the two best shops in her mother's dowry as soon as she opened her mouth.
"Oh! You kid is so greedy. You choose the good shop first and let me give my sister whatever she wants." Everything is expensive in the capital, and those two shops couldn't be bought for less than 30,000 to 50,000 taels. She originally planned to give twoKeep a room for each daughter, so that she will be confident when she gets married.
"Sister, you won't argue with me, right? I'm younger than you, so you have to let me." Zhao Ruoyu's eyes flashed with a hint of pride and cunning, and her childish face had the arrogance of an adult woman. In her mind, everything that was good belonged to her, and she would distribute the money she made to her sister who suffered losses.
Seeing her expression as if she had taken the shop as her own, Zhao Ruojin was secretly amused. She opened her eyes wide and said indifferently: "It doesn't matter. If my sister wants it, give it to her. I just want a small shop. Don't you have two shops on Fule Street? I'm not smart enough to open a big shop."
"But those two shops are really not big. Together they are not as big as one shop on East Street." You can buy them for six or seven thousand taels, and the area is not very prosperous.
"Mom, how about you give me another two hundred acres of land attached to the village, and I will open a rice shop in the future and sell home-grown rice. Then I don't have to worry about the supply of goods, and I don't have to worry about being cheated. I can make whatever I sell, and I won't lose money."
This was the most cost-effective way. She had to make money before she could think of anything else. After all, her age was not enough to convince people. No one would pay attention to her when she showed up to discuss business with others. She had to make some achievements first to be convincing, so as not to despise her because of her young age, make things more difficult for her on the price of goods, and deceive her into ignorance.
"Ah! That's good. Mom just has a small village with 250 acres of land. The annual rice output is quite a lot. If there are no floods or droughts, the rice you harvest will be enough for you to sell." Feeling that her eldest daughter had suffered a loss, Mrs. Xu took the initiative to give her the land she was least worried about. The rice grains were the least loss-making, and all the money she sold was money.
"Mom, I also want land." Seeing that her sister had it, Zhao Ruoyu, who hated farming the most, also yelled for it. Even if she saw that others had it, she must have it too.
Mrs. Xu looked at her little daughter with a slightly subtle look, and the smile on her face also faded. "Then I'll trade one of your shops with my sister, and my mother will also give you a village."
"No, I won't change it." When she thought about how valuable the shop on East Street was, she immediately guarded it tightly, fearing that others would come and rob it.
This kid is a bit spoiled. "Sister Xiao, don't be too greedy and eager for quick success. We have two daughters in our house. You and your sister should support each other when you get married. Don't ruin the sisterhood for small profits. No matter how close you are in this world, you can't be as close as your parents and siblings. Only your parents, brothers and sisters are truly good to you."
Zhao Ruoyu thought in her heart: It's strange, once there is a conflict of interest, no matter how close people are, they will turn against each other and become enemies. I don't trust anyone but myself. "Yes, mother, I don't want Zhuangzi anymore. Just two shops are enough to keep me busy. Alas! I'm so tired."
She was dissatisfied and pretended to be obedient, making her mother laugh.
"I'm so tired! I feel tired even before I finish it. How about you take the shop back so that you don't tire out my precious daughter?" She really couldn't bear to have her heart hurt.
"No, no, no, no, mother, I'm not afraid of getting tired. I'll make a lot of money to give you twelve pairs of gold masks, so you can wear them when you go out in glory." She had not yet made any money and boasted about it, as if the money was a stone on the ground, just scan it and you'll have it.
"Okay, Mom is waiting for your golden noodle, so you can show your respect. Sister Le, your shop is small, do you want Mom to provide subsidies... Hey! Why are you in a daze again? Did you listen to what Mom said?" After worrying about the younger ones, I came to worry about the older ones, the two girls who came to collect debts.
Zhao Ruojin, who was thinking about what to sell in another shop, came to her senses when her sister gently pulled her away. She smiled stupidly and said, "I don't need mother's help. It's just a small shop. And I've saved a lot of money in the past few years. I'm rich."
There are really a lot of treasures piled up in her little treasury, from her full-moon gift to every year's birthday, as well as the New Year's money given by her elders. There are also rewards in the palace, and her mother takes her and her sister to various houses. Who doesn't love the twins with pink makeup and jade? The ladies of the house are happy to see it, so they give gold and silver, longevity locks, and jade bracelets.Hairpins or something like that, if they don’t have a few hundred, they can’t give them away.
After all, where the portal is, the Xingwu Marquis Mansion is not an ordinary common people's home. The sacred favor is still there, and the family members are often escorted to the palace by the Queen and the Queen Mother. If the gift is given lightly, it will be embarrassing for the person giving the gift.
As a result, she received a lot of money and accumulated quite a lot of wealth in seven years.
Besides, she doesn't have much to spend money on. Unlike her younger sister, who spends money lavishly, wants to buy everything she sees, and loves people more than others. Speaking of which, Zhao Ruoyu's private house is not many, it's only a fraction of hers. Even if Zhao Ruoyu is given a big shop to make money, I'm afraid she won't be able to support it.
